cases.criteria: The cursor shows, moves and changes image (hardware cursor plane or the software cursor, as the result records), with no trails after window moves or VT switches
A RandR CRTC gamma ramp (xrandr --gamma) changes the panel output and the default ramp restores it exactly
XAllocColor and XQueryColors on the default TrueColor visual return exact pixel values; the DDX advertises no visual it cannot render
A DirectColor visual, if the DDX offers one, changes output through XStoreColors; otherwise none is advertised
xfwm4 with its compositor: redirected windows, shadows, opacity and a GL client in a window render correctly; no stale or leaked pixmaps after 10 min
A fullscreen GL client under the compositor unredirects (Present flips) and redirects back when covered
When the last client exits the server regenerates; the next session is accelerated again, five times in one boot
